messages:
Elena M.: Quick sync — want to run a 45m webinar + new FAQ pass + inbound routing experiment for pricing/tiers next week. Target: reduce 'which tier' support tickets by ~30% and bump demo signups by 10%.

Sam G.: Love it. Can we pair the webinar with a micro-calculator? small modal that recommends a tier based on usage. A/B test: calculator vs bullets.

Raj P.: Product constraints: calculator needs to map committed GPUs -> Dedicated pricing vs Hosted. I can provide a mapping CSV by EOD. Also we should freeze tier names before the webinar.

Maria S.: Sales ask: route obvious enterprise intent straight to AE queue, and low-effort demo leads to PLG nurture. Who owns the routing rules?

deploy-bot: staging infra available at 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC for tests. Deploy window: 09:00–11:00 UTC.

Sam G.: Draft routing rules (example):
```
if (annual_commit >= 5000 || company_size >= 100) -> AE_queue
else if (trial_type == 'pooled' || wants_dedicated == true) -> AE_queue
else if (engagement_score >= 50) -> PLG_nurture
else -> self_serve
```
We can tune thresholds after a week.

Elena M.: Webinar outline: 1) Pricing philosophy (cost vs reliability), 2) Live demo: calculator + quick flows, 3) FAQ refresh highlights, 4) Live Q&A. Plan two sessions (US-friendly and APAC-friendly).

Raj P.: For the FAQ, let's add a clear decision question: "How do I pick Dedicated vs Hosted?" with a 3-bullet decision tree and an example cost scenario. I can draft bullets by tomorrow.

Maria S.: Also need a sales-ready one-pager showing SLA, data isolation, and pricing anchors. Ops can own design + PDF generation.

Elena M.: @Maria S. ops can — thanks. Sam, can you own A/B test instrumentation? We'll track: `pricing_calc_shown`, `pricing_calc_submitted`, `lead_route`, `demo_request`.

Sam G.: Yep. I'll add the events and a small funnel dashboard in Amplitude. Also proposing a microcopy variant test on the calculator CTA: "See my estimated cost" vs "Which tier am I?"

Elena M.: Timeline: copy freeze Tue 2026-04-01, staging deploy Wed 2026-04-02, webinar Thu 2026-04-09. Please flag blockers ASAP.

Raj P.: Small product note: calculator must surface regional pricing (EU VAT) and optional committed discounts. Will add `region` + `tax_flag` to payload.

Sam G.: Noted — will include `region` and `tax_flag` in events.

Maria S.: :thumbsup: I'll prep AE script for Enterprise inbound and a short demo checklist.

Elena M.: One more thing — let's add a short FAQ snippet right on the pricing page: "What if my usage spikes?" -> automatic burst vs reserved guidance. Keeps support emails down.

Raj P.: Good call. I'll write the burst guidance.

Elena M.: OK — next check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT. Thanks all.
